scope: Read-only aggregate KPI baseline; no customer identifiers, credentials, checkout creation, tool execution or paid API calls.

commands.completed: stripe get /v1/checkout/sessions --live -d status=complete -d limit=100, cursor pagination to has_more=false
commands.rolling: stripe checkout sessions list --live --limit 100, cursor pagination until oldest predates seven days
commands.github: gh api repos/theluckystrike/mcp-servers/traffic/{views,clones,popular/referrers} and gh api repos/theluckystrike/mcp-servers

limitations: Completed Checkout history only; not every Stripe payment channel, net revenue or profit.
Other storefront counts are positive read controls only; unrelated amounts omitted.
Exact success_url hostname mcp.zovo.one; metadata.probe=1 excluded from commercial totals.
Untagged does not mean verified human.
Existing explicitly tagged test Sessions are reported separately, not commercial activity.

github.window: GitHub rolling 14-date traffic dataset, as served
limitations: Views, unique clients, clone requests and stars are not independently verified people, installs or successful jobs.
Daily uniques must not be summed as distinct people.
GitHub reporting can lag the current day; windows differ from Stripe and GSC.

search_console.source: Google Search Console searchAnalytics/query with read-only service-account JWT; HTTP and API errors explicitly checked
limitations: Inclusive date range is 29 dates, not exactly 28 days.
Search queries can be anonymized; visible query rows do not sum to page totals.
Impressions are not indexed-page counts; no current full URL inspection census.
search_console.freshness: Prior same-UTC-day finalized GSC data retained; current-date post-launch data are not available in this snapshot.

registry_referrals.freshness: Retained baseline without repeating the expensive seven-day Cloudflare scan.
limitations: Raw requests, not people or conversions.
Cannot causally attribute changes in a later window to directory placement.

upgrade_clicks.counting_rule: a click counts only when the request carries sec-fetch-mode: navigate AND sec-fetch-dest: document, its User-Agent names no crawler or HTTP library, it sends no x-mcp-probe header, it carries a Referer (any origin, real browsers always send one; scripts and the 2026-09-17 setup-page walker do not), and its ?src= is one a live page emits. Everything else is either not counted or bucketed under unattributed.*, which is excluded from total_clicks and clicks_7d.
upgrade_clicks.note: Browser-header guard reduces probes but does not identify humans. Historical counter is a positive read control; no synthetic click sent.
upgrade_clicks.freshness: Historical seven-day snapshot retained; not refreshed at R37 baseline.

matcher_launch_traffic.method: Read-only Cloudflare adaptive groups, exact path/host/time filters; all six groupings below 10000-row cap
limitations: Adaptive estimates may lag current time and include operator/automation requests.
Browser-style UA includes our known real Chrome QA; headers identifying probes are unavailable in this dataset.
Referrer categories do not identify people or prove interest, installs, tool success or willingness to pay.
Downloads is a shared catalog page; the monitor route is a positive logging control, not demand.
Window begins after first product deployment; zero rows are not proof of zero people.
matcher_launch_traffic.privacy: No client IPs, raw user agents, complete referrer hosts, tenant/session tokens or credentials exported.

directory.search_result: No results from two exact site-restricted web queries; not proof of absence or review status.
limitations: A submission receipt does not prove a listing.
Public directory pages challenge unauthenticated CLI access.
No account access, email check, sign-in or resubmission attempted.

public_sitemap_check.method: GET sitemap.xml, extract every loc, then GET all twelve child sitemaps (bounded at twenty); extract every loc; case-insensitive search three.?way|supplier.invoice.match|theluckystrike
public_sitemap_check.result: No three-way or supplier-invoice-match URL found in current advertised sitemaps; old estate URLs are present.
public_sitemap_check.limitation: Sitemap absence does not prove curator rejection or the absence of an unadvertised listing/alternate slug. Review status remains unverified.

assessment.conversion_rate_reason: No verified same-window buyer or successful-job denominator. Request counts and GitHub uniques cannot supply it.
assessment.next_measurement: Keep the next seven-day channel windows aligned. Measure crawl/index coverage and buyer-intent query clicks for the new task guide; measure a privacy-preserving demo completion/download/upgrade sequence with operator probes excluded, then compare untagged Stripe Sessions. Do not infer conversion or ROI until qualified usage and paid outcomes exist.
